example_uz: Yangi ma'lumotlarning qo'shilishi hisobot sifatini yaxshiladi.

definition_en: Used to express that you want something to happen.
example_en: Hopefully, the weather will be nice for our picnic tomorrow.
example_uz: Nasib bo'lsa ertangi saylimiz uchun ob-havo yaxshi bo'ladi.

definition_en: Very clever, talented, or extremely bright in light or color.
example_en: That was a brilliant idea to finish the project ahead of time.
example_uz: Loyiha muddatidan oldin yakunlash haqidagi fikringiz ajoyib edi.

definition_en: A kitchen tool used to flip food like pancakes or meat while cooking.
example_en: Use a turner to flip the pancakes so they cook on both sides.
example_uz: Pancakeni agdarish uchun kurakchadan foydalan.

definition_en: A thick, soft substance used for styling hair or cleaning the body.
example_en: He put some gel in his hair to keep it in place.
example_uz: Sochi joyida turishi uchun u sochiga gel surdi.

definition_en: Expressed or communicated through talking rather than writing.
example_en: Spoken English is often different from the formal written language.
example_uz: Ogzaki ingliz tili ko'pincha rasmiy yozma tildan farq qiladi.

definition_en: The final letter of the Greek alphabet, or the end of something.
example_en: This final achievement was the omega of his long career.
example_uz: Ushbu so'nggi yutuq uning uzoq faoliyatining intihosi edi.

definition_en: The act of ending something, especially a person's employment at a company.
example_en: The sudden termination of his contract left him without any financial support.
example_uz: Shartnomaning to'satdan bekor qilinishi uni moddiy yordamsiz qoldirdi.

definition_en: A person who puts money away instead of spending it all.
example_en: He is a natural saver and rarely buys things he does not need.
example_uz: U tabiatan tejamkor va kerak bo'lmagan narsalarni kamdan-kam sotib oladi.

definition_en: Of or about the thing just mentioned.
example_en: The contract and all terms thereof are binding for both parties.
example_uz: Shartnoma va uning barcha shartlari har ikki tomon uchun majburiydir.

definition_en: To cook food over a very hot fire or on a metal frame.
example_en: Why don't we get together Saturday and grill some burgers outside?
example_uz: Keling, shanba kuni yig'ilib, tashqarida burgerlarni grilda pishiramiz.

definition_en: To buy back something that you previously sold or gave away.
example_en: He managed to redeem his watch from the pawn shop yesterday.
example_uz: U kecha soatini garovxondan qaytarib sotib olishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

definition_en: The small, hard seeds of food plants like wheat, rice, or corn.
example_en: We stored a thousand tons of grain for the long winter.
example_uz: Biz uzoq qish uchun ming tonna don g'amlab qo'ydik.

definition_en: A casual way of saying 'want to' or 'want a'.
example_en: I really wanna go home after a very long and hard day.
example_uz: Uzoq va qiyin kundan keyin uyga ketgim kelyapti.

definition_en: An adult male animal of the cattle family.
example_en: The farmer kept a large bull in the field near the road.
example_uz: Fermer yo'l yaqinidagi dalada katta buqani saqlardi.

definition_en: Relating to the design and construction of buildings.
example_en: The old city is famous for its beautiful and unique architectural style.
example_uz: Qadimiy shahar o'zining go'zal va o'ziga xos me'moriy uslubi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: To be decided by or change because of something else.
example_en: Whether we play outside will depend on the weather tomorrow.
example_uz: Tashqarida o'ynashimiz ertangi ob-havoga bog'liq bo'ladi.

definition_en: To be not the same as another person or thing.
example_en: These two machines differ in speed but are otherwise the same.
example_uz: Bu ikkita mashina tezligi bilan farq qiladi, lekin qolgan jihatdan bir xil.

definition_en: A long waterproof coat that protects you from the rain.
example_en: She wore a yellow macintosh to stay dry during the heavy rain.
example_uz: U kuchli yomg'ir paytida xo'l bo'lmaslik uchun sariq yomg'irpo'sh kiyib olgandi.

definition_en: The air that you take into your lungs and let out through your nose or mouth.
example_en: I took a deep breath before jumping into the cold swimming pool.
example_uz: Sovuq basseynga sakrashdan oldin chuqur nafas oldim.

definition_en: Useful or pleasant features, services, or facilities in a place or building.
example_en: The hotel offers many amenities including a gym and a swimming pool.
example_uz: Mehmonxona sport zali va suzish havzasi kabi ko'plab qulayliklar taqdim etadi.

definition_en: Almost entirely; very close to something.
example_en: The company has virtually no competition in the current global market.
example_uz: Kompaniyaning hozirgi global bozorda deyarli raqobatchisi yo'q.

definition_en: A type of plant that includes vegetables like cabbage and broccoli.
example_en: Many gardeners grow cole crops because they tolerate cold weather quite well.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik bog'bonlar karam turidagi o'simliklarni ekadi, chunki ular sovuqqa chidamli.

definition_en: A place where goods are bought and sold; a market or store.
example_en: She went to the local mart to buy some fresh fruits and vegetables.
example_uz: U yangi meva va sabzavotlar sotib olish uchun mahalliy savdo markaziga bordi.

definition_en: A piece of wax with a string in the middle that gives light when burned.
example_en: We lit a candle when the electricity went out during the storm.
example_uz: Bo'ron paytida elektr energiyasi o'chganda biz sham yoqib oldik.

definition_en: Official permission to do something.
example_en: You need authorization from the manager before accessing the private computer files.
example_uz: Maxfiy kompyuter fayllariga kirishdan oldin menejerdan ruxsat olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A story, often one that is imaginative or invented.
example_en: The old man told a fascinating tale about his travels across the sea.
example_uz: Qariya dengiz bo'ylab qilgan sayohatlari haqida qiziqarli hikoya aytib berdi.

definition_en: happening or existing at some time in the past
example_en: This building was formerly a school for local children in the town.
example_uz: Bu bino ilgari mahalliy bolalar uchun maktab bo‘lgan.

definition_en: a device that shines light to show images or movies on a screen
example_en: Please turn on the projector so we can see the presentation slides.
example_uz: Iltimos taqdimot slaydlarini ko‘rishimiz uchun proyektorni yoqing.

definition_en: being in a particular place or position
example_en: Our new office is situated right in the center of the city.
example_uz: Yangi ofisimiz shahar markazida joylashgan.

definition_en: involving the study of how things are the same or different
example_en: The teacher asked us to write a comparative essay about two cultures.
example_uz: O‘qituvchi bizdan ikki madaniyat haqida qiyosiy insho yozishimizni so‘radi.

definition_en: made from plants or herbs, often for medical or flavor purposes
example_en: I prefer drinking herbal tea instead of coffee in the evening.
example_uz: Men kechqurun kofe o‘rniga o‘simliklardan tayyorlangan choy ichishni afzal ko‘raman.

definition_en: in a way that must be obeyed or followed completely
example_en: You must strictly follow the safety rules while working in the laboratory.
example_uz: Laboratoriyada ishlash jarayonida xavfsizlik qoidalariga qat’iy amal qilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Written or digital files containing important information or instructions.
example_en: Please check all the technical docs before you start the project.
example_uz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin barcha texnik hujjatlarni ko'rib chiqing.

definition_en: Relating to a person's mind and how they think or feel.
example_en: We are worried about the psychological effects of the pandemic on children.
example_uz: Biz pandemiyaning bolalar ruhiyatiga ta'siridan xavotirdamiz.

definition_en: A business that sells goods directly to the public in small quantities.
example_en: The largest retailer in the country is planning to open new stores.
example_uz: Mamlakatdagi eng yirik chakana savdo tarmog'i yangi do'konlar ochishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: Graceful, stylish, and pleasing in appearance or style.
example_en: She looked very elegant in her simple black evening dress.
example_uz: U o'zining oddiy qora kechki libosida juda nafis ko'rinardi.

definition_en: The act of starting something again or extending a contract.
example_en: The contract is coming up for renewal at the end of May.
example_uz: Shartnoma muddati may oyining oxirida tugaydi va uni yangilash kerak.

definition_en: The study of your family history and how your ancestors are connected.
example_en: She became interested in genealogy after finding her grandfather's old letters.
example_uz: Bobosining eski xatlarini topgach, u nasl-nasabini o'rganishga qiziqib qoldi.

definition_en: Feeling or showing strong disagreement or disapproval about a plan, idea, or person.
example_en: Many local residents are opposed to the construction of the new mall.
example_uz: Ko‘pchilik mahalliy aholi yangi savdo markazi qurilishiga qarshi chiqmoqda.

definition_en: People who judge or express their disapproval of someone or something.
example_en: Critics argued that the new policy would not solve the economic problem.
example_uz: Tanqidchilarning fikricha, yangi siyosat iqtisodiy muammoni hal qila olmaydi.

definition_en: In a way that is almost the same as something else.
example_en: The two brothers dress similarly and share the same sense of humor.
example_uz: Ikki aka-uka o‘xshash kiyinadi va bir xil hazil tuyg‘usiga ega.

definition_en: A small flat piece of metal used as money.
example_en: He dropped a small gold coin into the collection box for charity.
example_uz: U xayriya qutisiga bitta mayda oltin tanga tashladi.

definition_en: Only and not involving anyone or anything else.
example_en: The success of the project depended solely on his hard work.
example_uz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyati faqatgina uning mehnatiga bog‘liq edi.

definition_en: Not real; made to look genuine to trick people.
example_en: I am worried that this fur coat looks a bit fake.
example_uz: Bu mo'ynali kiyim soxtaga o'xshashidan xavotirdaman.

definition_en: A business where people go for beauty treatments like hair or nails.
example_en: She went to the local beauty salon for a new haircut.
example_uz: U soch turmagini yangilash uchun mahalliy go'zallik saloniga bordi.

definition_en: Involving two or more people working together to achieve a goal.
example_en: The final report was a collaborative effort by the whole team.
example_uz: Yakuniy hisobot butun jamoaning hamkorlikdagi mehnati mahsuli edi.

definition_en: A medicine or medical treatment that makes a sick person healthy again.
example_en: Scientists are still looking for a cure for this rare disease.
example_uz: Olimlar hali ham bu kamyob kasallikka davo izlashmoqda.

definition_en: A person who is in charge of a group of people in an army.
example_en: The commander ordered the soldiers to move forward to the next hill.
example_uz: Qo'mondon askarlarga keyingi tepalikka qarab yurishni buyurdi.

definition_en: A curved structure that supports the weight of a wall above an opening.
example_en: We walked through the ancient stone arch into the beautiful city square.
example_uz: Biz qadimiy tosh arka orqali go'zal shahar maydoniga kirib bordik.

definition_en: An idea or plan that you offer for someone to think about.
example_en: She had a great suggestion for how to improve our project results.
example_uz: U loyihamiz natijalarini yaxshilash uchun ajoyib taklif berdi.

definition_en: A person who serves in an army.
example_en: The soldier stood guard at the entrance of the military base daily.
example_uz: Askar har kuni harbiy baza kirish eshigida qorovul bo'lib turdi.

definition_en: A weapon that explodes and causes a lot of damage.
example_en: The soldiers were worried that a bomb might go off nearby.
example_uz: Askarlar bomba yaqin joyda portlab ketishidan xavotirda edilar.

definition_en: Physical or mental injury or damage caused to someone or something.
example_en: Smoking causes serious harm to your health over a long time.
example_uz: Chekish uzoq vaqt davomida sog'lig'ingizga jiddiy zarar yetkazadi.

definition_en: A state of being the person or thing that everyone is watching.
example_en: She has been in the spotlight ever since she won the award.
example_uz: U mukofotni yutib olganidan beri doim odamlarning diqqat markazida.

definition_en: To set something back to its starting state or position.
example_en: You need to reset your password if you forgot it.
example_uz: Agar parolingizni unutgan bo'lsangiz, uni qayta sozlashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A tool with hair used for cleaning, painting, or grooming.
example_en: She uses a soft brush to paint beautiful pictures on paper.
example_uz: U qog'ozga chiroyli rasmlar chizish uchun yumshoq cho'tkadan foydalanadi.

definition_en: To try to find out the truth about a crime, problem, or other event.
example_en: The police are currently trying to investigate the cause of the fire.
example_uz: Politsiya hozirda yong‘in sababini aniqlash uchun surishtiruv o‘tkazmoqda.

definition_en: To attack someone or something in a very violent or aggressive way.
example_en: He was arrested for attempting to assault a man in the street.
example_uz: U ko‘chada odamga hujum qilmoqchi bo‘lgani uchun qo‘lga olindi.

definition_en: Available to be used because it is extra and not currently being used.
example_en: Do you have a spare pen that I can borrow for class?
example_uz: Darsda ishlatish uchun ortiqcha ruchkangiz bormi?

definition_en: The planning and organization of moving goods or equipment from one place to another.
example_en: The company relies on complex logistics to deliver products across the country.
example_uz: Kompaniya mahsulotlarni butun mamlakat bo‘ylab yetkazib berishda murakkab logistikaga tayanadi.

definition_en: A wild animal with four legs that eats grass and often has antlers.
example_en: We saw a beautiful deer running through the forest this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab o‘rmon ichida yugurib ketayotgan chiroyli kiyikni ko‘rdik.

definition_en: The soft part in your mouth used for tasting and speaking.
example_en: She stuck out her tongue to show the doctor her throat.
example_uz: U shifokorga tomogini ko'rsatish uchun tilini chiqardi.

definition_en: A sweet, flaky bread roll that often contains fruit or cheese filling.
example_en: I usually have a coffee and a cherry danish for breakfast.
example_uz: Men nonushtaga odatda kofe va olchali qatlama yeyman.

definition_en: A very good friend that you like to spend your time with.
example_en: He has been my best pal since we were at school.
example_uz: U maktab davrimizdan beri eng yaqin do'stim.

definition_en: A small animal with a long tail that lives in trees in forests.
example_en: The monkey climbed to the top of the tree very quickly.
example_uz: Maymun juda tez daraxtning tepasiga chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: The specific title that you give to a digital file on a computer.
example_en: Make sure you choose a clear filename so you can find it later.
example_uz: Keyinchalik topish oson bo'lishi uchun aniq fayl nomi tanlaganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: Examines something in detail to understand it or explain how it works.
example_en: The report analyzes the current trends in the local housing market.
example_uz: Ushbu hisobot mahalliy uy-joy bozoridagi joriy tendensiyalarni tahlil qiladi.

definition_en: Pictures or diagrams made by using a pen, pencil, or crayon.
example_en: The architect presented her detailed drawings for the new house design.
example_uz: Me'mor yangi uy dizayni uchun batafsil chizmalarini taqdim etdi.

definition_en: The quality of being important or having a great effect on something.
example_en: The historical significance of this event is known by every local person.
example_uz: Bu voqeaning tarixiy ahamiyatini har bir mahalliy odam biladi.

definition_en: Two people who have a romantic or sexual relationship with each other.
example_en: The park is a popular place for young lovers to walk together.
example_uz: Bog' yosh sevishganlarning birga sayr qilishi uchun mashhur joy hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Relating to the energy released when the center of an atom is split.
example_en: Scientists study atomic energy as a way to generate clean electricity.
example_uz: Olimlar toza elektr energiyasini ishlab chiqarish usuli sifatida atom energiyasini o'rganadilar.

definition_en: Used to show that a number or amount is not exact.
example_en: The journey will take approx three hours depending on the heavy traffic.
example_uz: Yo'l tirbandlikka qarab taxminan uch soat vaqt oladi.

definition_en: A formal meeting where experts discuss a particular subject.
example_en: The university hosted a symposium on modern climate change solutions.
example_uz: Universitet zamonaviy iqlim o'zgarishi yechimlari bo'yicha simpozium o'tkazdi.

definition_en: To judge or estimate a person's feelings or the size of something.
example_en: It is difficult to gauge how people will react to the news.
example_uz: Odamlar yangilikka qanday munosabat bildirishini baholash qiyin.

definition_en: A place where two or more roads or railway lines meet.
example_en: You need to turn left when you reach the next road junction.
example_uz: Keyingi chorrahaga yetganingizda chapga burilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A small piece of thick fabric placed on the floor or a table surface.
example_en: Please wipe your dirty shoes on the mat before entering the house.
example_uz: Uyga kirishdan oldin oyoq kiyimingizni gilamchaga artib oling.

definition_en: To have sent electronic signals or information from one place to another.
example_en: The data was transmitted to the main office via a secure link.
example_uz: Ma'lumotlar xavfsiz aloqa orqali bosh idoraga yuborildi.

definition_en: An image showing the contents of a computer or phone screen.
example_en: I took some screenshots of the error message on my computer screen.
example_uz: Kompyuter ekranimdagi xatolik xabarining tasvirini olib qo'ydim.

definition_en: Involving a lot of activity, effort, or work in a short period.
example_en: We attended an intensive English course to prepare for the exams.
example_uz: Imtihonlarga tayyorlanish uchun biz jadallashtirilgan ingliz tili kursiga qatnashdik.

definition_en: Coming after the fifth in a series.
example_en: This is the sixth time I have visited this beautiful city.
example_uz: Bu mening ushbu go'zal shaharga oltinchi bor tashrif buyurishim.

definition_en: To involve someone in an activity or to pay attention to something.
example_en: It is difficult to engage students in such a boring lecture.
example_uz: Bunday zerikarli ma'ruzaga talabalarni jalb qilish qiyin.

definition_en: Different from what is considered normal or socially acceptable.
example_en: At the trial, the extent of his deviant behaviour became clear.
example_uz: Sud jarayonida uning odatdagidan farqli xatti-harakatlari aniq bo'ldi.

definition_en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
example_en: The race is due to start at noon sharp.
example_uz: Poyga aniq tush payti, soat 12 da boshlanishi kerak.

definition_en: The act of writing letters or emails to someone.
example_en: Please keep all your business correspondence in this folder.
example_uz: Iltimos, barcha ish yozishmalaringizni ushbu papkada saqlang.

definition_en: The act of watching and directing someone to ensure a task is done correctly.
example_en: Do not attempt this experiment without adequate adult supervision.
example_uz: Kattalar nazorati bo'lmasa, bu tajribani o'tkazishga urinmang.

definition_en: To behave dishonestly to gain an advantage in a game or exam.
example_en: My brother failed the exam because he cheated on the test.
example_uz: Akam imtihonda ko'chirgani uchun yiqildi.

definition_en: A hard brown metal made by mixing copper and tin.
example_en: The winners of the competition were awarded bronze medals.
example_uz: Musobaqa g'oliblariga bronza medallari topshirildi.

definition_en: Covered with or containing a large amount of sand.
example_en: Some plants grow very well in sandy soil.
example_uz: Ba'zi o'simliklar qumli tuproqda juda yaxshi o'sadi.

definition_en: The act of moving two or more things away from each other.
example_en: The separation of family members during the war was very difficult.
example_uz: Urush davrida oila a'zolarining bir-biridan ajralishi juda qiyin edi.

definition_en: To believe that someone is guilty of doing something wrong.
example_en: Police suspect him of being involved in the robbery.
example_uz: Politsiya uni o'g'rilikka aloqador deb gumon qilmoqda.

definition_en: People who are very famous and often seen in the media.
example_en: Many celebrities support various charity organizations around the world.
example_uz: Ko'plab mashhurlar dunyo bo'ylab turli xayriya tashkilotlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

definition_en: Relating to things on a very large scale.
example_en: We need to look at the macro economic situation of the country.
example_uz: Biz mamlakatning makroiqtisodiy holatiga nazar tashlashimiz kerak.

definition_en: A person or company that sends a letter or package.
example_en: The address of the sender was written on the back of the envelope.
example_uz: Konvertning orqasida jo'natuvchining manzili yozilgan edi.

definition_en: A real or imagined line that marks the edge of something.
example_en: It is important to set clear boundaries between work and home life.
example_uz: Ish va uy hayoti o'rtasida aniq chegaralarni belgilash muhimdir.

definition_en: The process of selling articles or shows to many different media companies.
example_en: The show became profitable after its successful international syndication.
example_uz: Serial xalqaro miqyosda muvaffaqiyatli tarqatilgandan so'ng foyda keltira boshladi.

definition_en: A place with equipment where people go to do physical exercise and training.
example_en: I go to the gym three times a week to stay fit.
example_uz: Formada qolish uchun haftasiga uch marta sportzalga boraman.

definition_en: A social event held to mark a special day or a happy occasion.
example_en: The whole village joined the celebration of the national holiday yesterday.
example_uz: Butun qishloq kecha milliy bayram tantanasiga qo‘shildi.

definition_en: A person's partner in marriage.
example_en: You must provide details of your spouse on the application form.
example_uz: Ariza shaklida turmush o‘rtog‘ingiz haqidagi ma’lumotlarni ko‘rsatishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Unusual and attractive because it comes from a distant, foreign place.
example_en: She loves travelling to exotic countries to see different cultures and landscapes.
example_uz: U boshqa madaniyat va manzaralarni ko‘rish uchun ekzotik davlatlarga sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko‘radi.

definition_en: A person who watches television or a public event.
example_en: The documentary attracted millions of viewers from around the world.
example_uz: Hujjatli film dunyo bo‘ylab millionlab tomoshabinlarni o‘ziga jalb qildi.

definition_en: The act of registering your name to join a service or event.
example_en: You need to complete the online signup to access the members area.
example_uz: A’zolar hududiga kirish uchun onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tishni yakunlashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A part of a cell that receives signals from specific molecules to control cell function.
example_en: The drug works by blocking the specific receptor on the cell surface.
example_uz: Dori hujayra yuzasidagi maxsus retseptorni to‘sib qo‘yish orqali ta’sir qiladi.

definition_en: Relating to medical operations or performed with extreme precision and care.
example_en: The pilot performed a surgical strike to avoid hitting the nearby houses.
example_uz: Uchuvchi yaqin-atrofdagi uylarga ziyon yetkazmaslik uchun o‘ta aniq zarba berdi.

definition_en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used or no longer exists.
example_en: The strong winds destroyed the old fence in our backyard last night.
example_uz: O‘tgan kecha kuchli shamol hovlimizdagi eski panjarani vayron qildi.

definition_en: A reference to a book, article, or author used as evidence in a report.
example_en: The essay failed because it lacked a proper citation for the statistics.
example_uz: Insho statistik ma’lumotlar uchun to‘g‘ri manba ko‘rsatilmagani sababli past baholandi.

definition_en: A thick, dark, sticky substance that comes from trees or is made from oil.
example_en: The wooden boat was sealed with pitch to prevent any water leaks.
example_uz: Suv o‘tkazmasligi uchun yog‘och qayiqqa qatron surtib chiqildi.

definition_en: An alcoholic drink made by fermenting the juice of pears.
example_en: We ordered a bottle of dry perry to go with our dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqat bilan ichish uchun bir shisha nok vinosiga buyurtma berdik.

definition_en: Causing someone to feel deeply hurt, upset, or angry because of rude behavior.
example_en: He made an offensive remark that made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
example_uz: U xonadagi hamma odamni noqulay ahvolga soladigan haqoratli gap aytdi.

definition_en: Connected to an empire or the ruler of an empire.
example_en: The museum holds many artifacts from the former imperial palace grounds.
example_uz: Muzeyda sobiq imperator saroyi hududidan topilgan ko'plab eksponatlar saqlanadi.

definition_en: A group or set of twelve items.
example_en: Can I please have a dozen eggs for my morning breakfast?
example_uz: Iltimos, ertalabki nonushtam uchun bir o'n ikkita tuxum bera olasizmi?

definition_en: A common slang term for a United States one hundred dollar bill.
example_en: He pulled a crisp Benjamin from his wallet to pay quickly.
example_uz: U tezda to'lov qilish uchun hamyonidan yuz dollarlik chiqardi.

definition_en: The act of moving something into a position to be used effectively.
example_en: The company planned the deployment of the new software for Monday.
example_uz: Kompaniya yangi dasturiy ta'minotni dushanba kuni o'rnatishni rejalashtirgan.

definition_en: Hard, white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing food.
example_en: It is important to brush your teeth at least twice daily.
example_uz: Tishlarni kuniga kamida ikki marta yuvish juda muhim.

example_en: Software enhancement makes the program run much faster and more smoothly.
example_uz: Dasturiy ta'minotni yangilash dasturning tezroq va ravon ishlashini ta'minlaydi.

definition_en: An exact copy of a living thing or an object produced identically.
example_en: The scientists were able to create a genetic clone of the sheep.
example_uz: Olimlar qo'yni genetik jihatdan klonlashga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.

definition_en: The speed of something moving in a particular direction.
example_en: The rocket increased its velocity as it moved away from the earth.
example_uz: Raketa yerdan uzoqlashgani sari o'z tezligini oshirdi.

definition_en: The eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet, often used as a scientific symbol.
example_en: In physics, lambda is frequently used to represent the wavelength of light.
example_uz: Fizikada lambda ko'pincha yorug'lik to'lqin uzunligini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

definition_en: To receive and send on information or messages to another person or place.
example_en: Please relay this important message to the manager as soon as possible.
example_uz: Iltimos bu muhim xabarni imkon qadar tezroq menejerga yetkazing.

definition_en: Feeling calm and in control of your emotions even in a difficult situation.
example_en: She remained composed while answering the difficult questions during the press conference.
example_uz: Matbuot anjumanida qiyin savollarga javob berayotganda u juda vazmin bo'ldi.

definition_en: Drops of salty liquid that come from your eyes when you are crying.
example_en: She had tears in her eyes after watching the sad movie scene.
example_uz: Kino sahnasidagi qayg'uli lahzani ko'rib, ko'zlariga yosh keldi.

definition_en: A starting value or line used for comparing or measuring future results.
example_en: We need to establish a baseline before we start measuring the project progress.
example_uz: Loyiha taraqqiyotini o'lchashdan oldin biz boshlang'ich nuqtani belgilab olishimiz kerak.

definition_en: The part of a truck, train, or crane where the driver sits.
example_en: The driver climbed into the truck cab and started the powerful engine.
example_uz: Haydovchi yuk mashinasi kabinasiga chiqib, kuchli dvigatelni yoqdi.

definition_en: Large groups of people who live together in an organized way.
example_en: Modern societies rely heavily on technology for daily communication and work.
example_uz: Zamonaviy jamiyatlar kundalik muloqot va ishda texnologiyalarga juda tayanadi.

definition_en: A chemical element used widely in computer chips and electronic devices.
example_en: Silicon is the essential material used to manufacture modern computer processor chips.
example_uz: Kremniy zamonaviy kompyuter protsessorlarini ishlab chiqarishda ishlatiladigan asosiy xomashyodir.

definition_en: A natural dark liquid found under the ground that is processed to make fuel.
example_en: The global economy relies heavily on the production of petroleum for energy.
example_uz: Jahon iqtisodiyoti energiya uchun neft qazib olishga juda bog'liq.

definition_en: To try to win something or be more successful than other people.
example_en: Local businesses must compete with large companies to stay in the market.
example_uz: Mahalliy korxonalar bozorda qolish uchun yirik kompaniyalar bilan raqobatlashishi kerak.

definition_en: A person who has a very strong interest in or enthusiasm for something.
example_en: As a true lover of music, she spends all her money on concerts.
example_uz: Musiqaning haqiqiy ishqibozi bo'lgani uchun u bor pulini konsertlarga sarflaydi.

definition_en: The two soft edges at the entrance of a person's mouth.
example_en: She put some red lipstick on her lips before going to the party.
example_uz: U kechaga ketishdan oldin lablariga qizil bo'yoq surdi.

definition_en: The ability to keep something or the power to remember information.
example_en: The company has a good strategy for the retention of talented employees.
example_uz: Kompaniya iqtidorli xodimlarni saqlab qolish uchun yaxshi strategiyaga ega.

definition_en: A small area of still water, often man-made.
example_en: We watched the ducks swimming happily in the garden pond.
example_uz: Biz o'rdaklarning bog'dagi hovuzda mazza qilib suzayotganini kuzatdik.

definition_en: The music and sound recorded for a movie or video game.
example_en: I love the soundtrack of that movie; it has amazing songs.
example_uz: Menga o'sha kinoning saundtreki juda yoqadi; unda ajoyib qo'shiqlar bor.

definition_en: A word used by children to address their father.
example_en: The little girl ran quickly to give her daddy a hug.
example_uz: Kichkina qizcha otasini quchoqlash uchun yugurib keldi.

definition_en: A boat used to carry people or vehicles across a river or sea.
example_en: We took the ferry to get to the island early morning.
example_uz: Biz erta tongda orolga yetib olish uchun paromga o'tirdik.

definition_en: A type of job that requires special education and training.
example_en: Medicine is a demanding profession that requires years of hard study.
example_uz: Tibbiyot ko'p yillik o'qishni talab qiladigan mashaqqatli kasbdir.

definition_en: A wall built across a river to stop the water from flowing.
example_en: A dam is often an essential source of water for farmers.
example_uz: To'g'on ko'pincha dehqonlar uchun muhim suv manbai hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Not together; in a way that involves keeping things apart.
example_en: We have been living separately for three years now.
example_uz: Biz uch yildan beri alohida yashayapmiz.

definition_en: The study of how the bodies of living things work.
example_en: The university course explores human physiology and how cells function.
example_uz: Universitet kursi inson fiziologiyasi va hujayralar qanday ishlashini o'rganadi.

definition_en: To feel or become tired or weary from working or waiting.
example_en: You will tire quickly if you do not get enough sleep.
example_uz: Agar yetarlicha uxlamasangiz, tez charchab qolasiz.

definition_en: A person who takes part in an event or activity.
example_en: All participants must adhere to the rules of the competition.
example_uz: Barcha ishtirokchilar musobaqa qoidalariga amal qilishlari shart.

definition_en: Related to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.
example_en: The city has built many new recreational areas for the public.
example_uz: Shahar aholi uchun ko'plab yangi dam olish maskanlarini qurdi.

definition_en: A very small part of an atom that has a negative electric charge.
example_en: The flow of an electron creates electricity in a wire.
example_uz: Elektron harakati simda elektr tokini hosil qiladi.

definition_en: The happy relationship between two or more friends.
example_en: Their friendship has lasted for over twenty years.
example_uz: Ularning do'stligi yigirma yildan ortiq davom etmoqda.

definition_en: A small plant with tiny purple or white flowers that grows on hills.
example_en: The hillside was covered in purple heather during the summer.
example_uz: Yozda tog' yonbag'ri binafsha rangli veresk bilan qoplangan edi.

definition_en: A hotel located near a highway where you can park your car right outside your room.
example_en: We stopped at a cheap motel to sleep for the night while traveling.
example_uz: Sayohat paytida bir kecha dam olish uchun arzon motelga to‘xtadik.

definition_en: The department of a government that manages the country's money and taxes.
example_en: The national treasury announced new budget cuts to improve the economic situation.
example_uz: Iqtisodiy vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun davlat g‘aznasi yangi xarajatlarni qisqartirishni e’lon qildi.

definition_en: A legal document signed by a judge that allows police to do something.
example_en: The police had a warrant to search the house for hidden evidence.
example_uz: Politsiyaning uy ichidan yashirin dalillarni izlash uchun sud orderi bor edi.

definition_en: Changed into ice or kept at a very low temperature to prevent decay.
example_en: We bought some frozen vegetables to cook for dinner this evening.
example_uz: Bugun kechki ovqatga tayyorlash uchun muzlatilgan sabzavotlar sotib oldik.

definition_en: To tease someone in a light and friendly way without being mean.
example_en: I was only just joshing with you about your new haircut, don't worry.
example_uz: Yangi sochingiz haqida shunchaki hazillashayotgan edim, xavotir olmang.

definition_en: People who belong to the family of a king or queen.
example_en: Many members of the royalty attended the event at the royal palace.
example_uz: Qirol saroyidagi tadbirda qirollik oilasining ko‘plab vakillari ishtirok etishdi.

definition_en: A large public meeting held to support a political cause or a common interest.
example_en: Thousands of people gathered in the park for the election rally.
example_uz: Saylovoldi mitingida ishtirok etish uchun minglab odamlar bog'ga to'planishdi.

definition_en: A person who watches or monitors something to see what happens.
example_en: The international observer watched the voting process throughout the entire day.
example_uz: Xalqaro kuzatuvchi butun kun davomida ovoz berish jarayonini kuzatib bordi.

definition_en: The light and heat that come from the sun.
example_en: We walked in the warm sunshine during our trip to the coast.
example_uz: Sohilga sayohatimiz davomida biz iliq quyosh nurlari ostida sayr qildik.

definition_en: To pull something heavy slowly along the ground.
example_en: He had to drag the heavy table across the wooden floor.
example_uz: U og'ir stolni yog'och pol bo'ylab sudrab olib o'tishi kerak edi.

definition_en: In a way that is not known or by some means.
example_en: Somehow, she managed to finish the report before the deadline arrived.
example_uz: Qandaydir yo'l bilan u hisobotni belgilangan muddatgacha tugatishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

definition_en: Being kept in legal custody because of a crime.
example_en: The arrested man was taken to the police station for questioning.
example_uz: Hibsga olingan shaxs so'roq qilinishi uchun politsiya bo'limiga olib ketildi.

definition_en: Connected with a region outside the capital city, often considered old-fashioned.
example_en: He grew tired of his provincial life and moved to the big city.
example_uz: U o'zining provinsial hayotidan charchadi va katta shaharga ko'chib o'tdi.

definition_en: Fully grown and ready to be eaten or used.
example_en: These tomatoes are red and ripe enough to pick today.
example_uz: Bu pomidorlar qizargan va terib olish uchun yetilgan.

definition_en: Coming to the end of life or reaching the final moments.
example_en: The old tree stood alone in the dying light of evening.
example_uz: Qari daraxt kechki xira yorug'likda yolg'iz qolgandi.

definition_en: Clothes, sheets, and towels that need to be washed or have just been washed.
example_en: I need to do the laundry before the weekend starts.
example_uz: Dam olish kunigacha kir yuvib olishim kerak.

definition_en: Unable to move or caught in a position where you cannot escape.
example_en: The key is stuck in the lock and I cannot turn it.
example_uz: Kalit qulfga tiqilib qoldi va men uni buray olmayapman.

definition_en: A person or company that pays for advertisements to promote their products or services.
example_en: The advertiser spent a lot of money to reach new potential customers.
example_uz: Reklamachi yangi mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun ko‘p pul sarfladi.

definition_en: Refers to computer files or programs that you can transfer from the internet to your device.
example_en: This website offers many free downloadable resources for students and teachers.
example_uz: Bu sayt o‘quvchilar va o‘qituvchilar uchun ko‘plab bepul yuklab olsa bo‘ladigan resurslarni taklif etadi.

definition_en: A state of complete quiet where there is no sound at all.
example_en: When the teacher walked into the room, there was absolute silence.
example_uz: O‘qituvchi xonaga kirganida, mutlaq sukunat hukm surdi.

definition_en: Something that you own or have in your control at a particular time.
example_en: He lost all his worldly possessions in the terrible house fire.
example_uz: U dahshatli yong‘in tufayli barcha mol-mulkidan ayrildi.

definition_en: Relating to the human voice or expressed strongly through speaking.
example_en: She was very vocal about her disagreement with the new company policy.
example_uz: U kompaniyaning yangi siyosatiga rozi emasligini ochiqchasiga aytdi.

definition_en: A person who teaches someone how to do a sport or develop a specific skill.
example_en: My tennis trainer helps me to improve my skills every single day.
example_uz: Tennis bo‘yicha murabbiyim har kuni mahoratimni oshirishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: A part of a living body that has a specific job, like the heart.
example_en: The heart is a vital organ that pumps blood through our bodies.
example_uz: Yurak qonni tanamiz bo‘ylab haydab beruvchi muhim a'zo hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Having more power, energy, or force than someone or something else.
example_en: Compared to the previous semester, my grades now are a lot stronger.
example_uz: Oldingi semestrga qaraganda baholarim ancha yaxshilandi.

definition_en: An oval yellow fruit that has a very sour juice and taste.
example_en: I always add a slice of fresh lemon to my hot tea.
example_uz: Men har doim issiq choyimga bir bo‘lak limon qo‘shaman.

definition_en: A situation where there is little or no light at all.
example_en: The darkness of the room made it difficult to see anything inside.
example_uz: Xonadagi qorong‘ulik tufayli ichkarida hech narsani ko‘rib bo‘lmasdi.

definition_en: The hard part at the end of each finger or toe on a person.
example_en: When I am nervous I tend to bite my nails without thinking.
example_uz: Asabiylashganimda o‘ylamasdan tirnoqlarimni tishlashga moyilman.

definition_en: To extend across a distance or a period of time.
example_en: The modern highway spans the entire length of the beautiful valley.
example_uz: Zamonaviy shosse butun vodiy bo‘ylab cho‘zilib ketgan.

definition_en: Something that you say or do to make people laugh.
example_en: He told a funny joke and everyone in the room laughed.
example_uz: U qiziqarli hazil aytdi va xonadagi hamma kuldi.

definition_en: A person who answers questions, especially in a survey or study.
example_en: Every respondent answered the survey questions honestly and with great care.
example_uz: Har bir respondent so‘rovnoma savollariga xolis va e’tibor bilan javob berdi.

definition_en: A formal written law established by a country's legislative body.
example_en: The new statute limited working hours for all factory employees.
example_uz: Yangi qonun barcha zavod xodimlarining ish vaqtini cheklab qo'ydi.

definition_en: To provide exactly what is needed or wanted by someone.
example_en: That brief explanation will never satisfy the curious students.
example_uz: Qisqacha izoh qiziquvchan talabalarni hech qachon qanoatlantirmaydi.

definition_en: A place that provides protection from bad weather or danger.
example_en: Along with food, shelter is often recognized as a human necessity.
example_uz: Oziq-ovqat bilan bir qatorda boshpana ham insonning asosiy ehtiyoji hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A small building or room used for private prayer and worship.
example_en: The quiet wedding ceremony took place in a small wooden chapel.
example_uz: Tinch nikoh marosimi kichik yog'och ibodatxonada bo'lib o'tdi.

definition_en: To make products on a large scale using machines.
example_en: The factory will manufacture parts for new electric cars next year.
example_uz: Zavod kelgusi yili yangi elektromobillar uchun ehtiyot qismlar ishlab chiqaradi.

definition_en: The state of being weak and easy to hurt or attack.
example_en: The security team identified a vulnerability in the company's computer network.
example_uz: Xavfsizlik guruhi kompaniya kompyuter tarmog'idagi zaiflikni aniqladi.

definition_en: The quality of being responsible for your actions and willing to explain them.
example_en: The manager demands accountability from every member of the project team.
example_uz: Menejer loyiha jamoasining har bir aʼzosidan masʼuliyat talab qiladi.

definition_en: Having official approval to do something or meet certain professional standards.
example_en: You should only study at an accredited university to get a degree.
example_uz: Diplom olish uchun faqat akkreditatsiyadan oʻtgan universitetda oʻqishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Pressed or squeezed into a smaller space or size.
example_en: The files were compressed to make them easier to send by email.
example_uz: Fayllar elektron pochta orqali yuborish oson boʻlishi uchun siqildi.

definition_en: A substance made by combining two or more different things together.
example_en: The soil is a mixture of sand and organic material.
example_uz: Tuproq qum va organik moddalarning aralashmasidan iborat.

definition_en: A long seat for several people, usually made of wood or metal.
example_en: They sat on a park bench and watched the sunset together.
example_uz: Ular bogʻdagi oʻrindiqqa oʻtirib, quyosh botishini birga tomosha qilishdi.

definition_en: A wide, open, round container used for holding food or washing things.
example_en: She bought a large tub of fresh yogurt from the local shop.
example_uz: U mahalliy do'kondan bir lagan yangi qatiq sotib oldi.

definition_en: A person who is riding a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle.
example_en: The experienced rider guided his horse carefully along the narrow mountain path.
example_uz: Tajribali chavandoz otini tor tog' yo'li bo'ylab ehtiyotkorlik bilan boshqardi.

definition_en: The thick bone in the forearm that is located on the thumb side.
example_en: The doctor examined the patient's arm to check if the radius was broken.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorning qo'lini tekshirib, bilak suyagi singan-sinmaganini aniqladi.
